full_page.content:
Page 273 Cont.
April 15 Joseph Copper - 14 - driving home from church last Sunday had accident - colision with neighbor boy 16 - now found to have diptheria also.
Countiss Karola Zagorska - 48 - was one renouned as an artist in music & singing. Baby Mary Forbs born day before yesterday, defective back
Page 274
April Isabelle Finch - 21 - in Hotel Dien - only sister died 17 years ago - Sunday had 104 fever ... was enrolled Monday when all hope was reported as vanished ..... When mother got back to hospit. fever was gone. Yes- terday was able to take nourishment O.K. Deo Gr.
17 Irene Barlow - 14 - non Cath. - Epileptic 82 yrs. - had 3 seisures To- day already, Enrolled annually
18 Mrs. Eliz. Hild - 6342 Kercheval - wants 2 rooms - for light cooking
18 Mrs. Lillian Rakowski - 58 - inward cancer, quite threatening.
19 Mrs. Sadie Hoyt - 66 - non Cath. almost blind
Mrs. Isabelle Reider - 60 - has had ten serious operations for tuomers - now they threaten to cancerous. ..
Gordon T. Duprey - 58 - nerveous - etc
22 Clementine LaBeau - 65 - threatened with loss of sight .....
Catherine LeGrasso - 22 To-day - scrupulos .... Hopes for grace to make a good confession.
Page 275 Apr. 23 Mrs. Rena Suthutherland - 55 - "dying of cancer" - ought to be Cath- olic but refuses to see any religious service ....
Sherman Leisure of Bay City - non Cath. - % phone - unconscious since last Saturday ..... Drs. Baffeled
Mrs. Breslin - 65 - 14 yrs. in wheel-cahir . . . ..
Eliz. Hild - wants 2 rooms ... If known of let me know.
